counterhypotheses.claim: Raw Qwen3.5 visual features are not trained as calibrated identity/open-set embeddings; contrastive/adapted multimodal embedding models demonstrate that embedding quality can require a distinct objective.
counterhypotheses.required_control: Dedicated lightweight embedding encoder with identical prototype/readout policy and complete pathway resource accounting.

counterhypotheses.claim: The reported multimodal slot-save limitation may not reproduce on Frank's exact Qwen3.5/libmtmd build or may be bypassed by a different supported persistence mechanism.
counterhypotheses.required_control: Exact target-VPS crash/save/restore test before declaring re-encode recovery mandatory.

counterhypotheses.claim: Feature-space temporal pruning may merely duplicate work already done by ROI/delta gating and can introduce stale-history errors.
counterhypotheses.required_control: Pre-encoder-only versus combined two-stage temporal policy under matched GUI episodes including off-ROI modals and stale history.
